SELECT cls, boat,
  SUM(yt) as yt,
  SUM(anglers) as anglers,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) as rate
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 77 AND 91
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter','overnight')
GROUP BY cls, boat
HAVING SUM(anglers) >= 15
ORDER BY rate DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT cls,
  SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) as rate,
  SUM(anglers) as anglers, COUNT(*) trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 61 AND 91
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY rate DESC
